_readme: Curated overview data for admin/repo-map.html — the branch/workflow inventory.
This file supplies the 'why' a GitHub API call cannot answer: category, purpose,
and a recommendation per branch and workflow. The page overlays this with LIVE
data (ahead/behind, last run, last commit) fetched from the GitHub API at view time.
'category' for workflows: content-import | enrichment | ocr | search-index |
Hand-maintained. Update when a branch/workflow's role changes — this is not
Analysis date: 2026-09-05. Verified via: git merge-base --is-ancestor (ancestry),
git diff --stat against origin/main (content overlap), and the GitHub PR list

snapshot.* on each branch = git-verified data as of the analysis date above (ahead/behind vs main, ancestry, last commit). Baked in so the page shows real numbers with zero GitHub API calls; a per-branch 'Refresh live' button re-checks on demand.

main.purpose: The live branch. GitHub Pages serves this directly — any push here is the deploy.
main.notes: Protected in practice by the safe-merge workflow discipline, not by a GitHub branch-protection rule.

kavya-dist.purpose: The built Kāvya corpus (43 works, 68 layers, 94,949 entries) — kept off main to stay under the GitHub Pages size limit, served to the browser via jsDelivr.
kavya-dist.notes: Referenced live in dge/js/config.js and dge/js/kavya.js. Rebuilt by import-kavya.yml.

check-sources.yml.purpose: Checks all 17 outside sources for updates twice a month (1st & 16th, 11:30am IST) and opens an issue if anything moved. Imports nothing.

sync-dvaitavedanta.yml.purpose: Twice-monthly (2nd & 17th, 9:00am IST) page-census diff against dvaitavedanta.in; spot-checks stored text for drift; names exactly which granthas need re-extraction. Imports nothing.

darshanas.yml.purpose: Scaffolds and ingests Darshana-branch content (choice of action).

extract-dvaitavedanta.yml.purpose: Extracts a chosen section of dvaitavedanta.in into dv-cache-dist, then into the library.

extract-setutila.yml.purpose: Imports/re-imports SetuTila posts by slug (or a full delta).

gemini-bench.yml.purpose: Benchmarks Gemini batching/concurrency settings against a sample sarga.

gemini-deep-analysis-kavya.yml.purpose: Deep grammatical analysis pass (chandas/alaṅkāra/samāsa/pratipadārtha) over a Kāvya sarga directory.

gemini-dhatu-lexicon.yml.purpose: Generates multilingual (11-language) dhātu meanings for chosen roots or ranges.

gemini-enrich.yml.purpose: Local reference-resolution + footnote enrichment for one grantha data.json.

gemini-summarize-kavya.yml.purpose: Padaccheda/anvaya/summary generation over a Kāvya sarga directory.

import-dasa-sahitya.yml.purpose: Imports Dāsa Sāhitya compositions from source indices.

import-kavya.yml.purpose: Imports Kāvya works by id (or 'all') into kavya-dist.

ingest-sayana-smriti.yml.purpose: Imports Sāyaṇa Bhāṣya and Smṛti commentaries (choice of importer).

ingest.yml.purpose: The original general-purpose text importer (single text at a time). Superseded in practice by the more specific ingest-*.yml workflows for new work, but still functional.

interlink.yml.purpose: Auto-runs deep cross-reference interlinking whenever dge/data/** changes on main (excluding the prayoga_index cache).

kavya-tracker.yml.purpose: Refreshes the Kāvya coverage tracker after a Kāvya import republishes the corpus.

ocr-lakshmi-kaumudi.yml.purpose: Server-side OCR for the Lakṣmī Vyākhyā (Sanskrit, pratīka-mode), page-range scoped.

ocr-sanskrit-commentary.yml.purpose: General server-side OCR for a Sanskrit/Kannada scanned commentary PDF.

ocr-vasu-kaumudi.yml.purpose: OCR for S.C. Vasu's Siddhānta-Kaumudī English translation, by archive.org volume.
